name: Are there financial assistance programs for barrier-free home modifications in California?

mainEntity.name: Are there financial assistance programs for barrier-free home modifications in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: While City Dweller, LLC does not directly offer financial assistance, there are various potential programs and resources available in California that may help offset the cost of barrier-free modifications. These can include state-specific programs for seniors or individuals with disabilities, grants from non-profit organizations, or tax deductions for medical expenses. Some long-term care insurance policies might also cover certain home modifications. It is recommended to research local and state government websites, and consult with financial advisors or disability advocacy groups to explore eligible options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financial assistance may be available through state programs, non-profit grants, tax deductions, or long-term care insurance. Research state and local resources.
